paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupihua,
heading: Pumpi A Pan Siang Lou Pawtte
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: Israel suante houpih unla, akiang uah, 'Mi kuapeuh sa a thil apawtleh athilpawt ziak in siang lou ahi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.

paite: Athilpawt sung teng siang lou ahi a, asa ah apawt gige hiam, apawt atawpta hiam leng hitaleh, amah siang lou himhim ahi.
english: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.

paite: Thilpawtmi lupna peuhmah siang lou ahi dia; atutna peuhmah leng siang lou ahi lai ding hi.
english: “‘Every bed whereon he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.

paite: Kuapeuh alupna khoih peuhmahte'n apuante uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.
english: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Thilpawtmi tutna a tu peuhmahte'n apuante uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uh.
english: He who sits on anything whereon the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Kuapeuh thilpawtmi sa khoih peuhmah in apuante uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.
english: “‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Thilpawtmi in misiang chil asiatkhumleh apuante asawp dia, akisil ding ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: “‘If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Tuanna bangpeuh a leng thilpawtmi atuanleh siang lou ahi ding.
english: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.

paite: Kuapeuh akingaihnasa nung thil khoih peuhmahte nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding ua; huai thil lasuan mi peuhmah in apuante uh asawp ding ua; akisil ding uh ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.
english: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. He who carries those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Kuapeuh thilpawtmi in akhut sil lou a akhoih peuhmah in apuante asawp dia, akisil ding ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: “‘Whoever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Thilpawtmi leibel khoihsa suktap ding ahi; asing vanzat tengteng silsiang vek ding ahi,' achi hi.
english: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

paite: "Huan thilpawtmi bel, athilpawt hihsiang ahihleh, akisiansakna ding in ni sagih akipe dia, apuante asawp dia; luitui ah akisil dia; huchi in ahong siangta ding hi.
english: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

paite: Ani giat ni in vakhu kop khat hiam, vapalnou kop khat hiam tawi in TOUPA ma ah kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah ahoh dia, siampu ape ding ahi.
english: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before Yahweh to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest:

paite: Siampu in khelh thoihna ding in khat, halmang thillat ding in akhat pen alan ding hi. Siampu in athilpawt thu ah TOUPA ma ah kilemna abawlsak ding.
english: and the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh for his discharge.

paite: "Pasal kuapeuh kipolhna chi amah a pan apawtleh apumpi in akisil vek dia, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: “‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Puansilh leh vun, kipolhna chitukna peuhmah sawpsiang vek ding ahi a, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: Every garment, and every skin, whereon the semen is, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Numei akithuahpih leng anih ua akisil tuak ding uh ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.
english: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: "Numei in thilpawt aneih a, asa a thilpawt si ahihleh ni sagih sung siang lou ahi dia; kuapeuh amah khoih kha taphot nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days: and whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.

paite: Asian louh sung a, alupna peuhmah siang lou ahi dia, atutna peuhmah leng siang lou ahi lai ding hi.
english: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.

paite: Alupna khoih peuhmahte'n apuante uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uh.
english: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Kuapeuh atutna khoih peuhmahte'n apuante uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.
english: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Alupna a thil om hiam, atutna a thil om hiam khoih peuhmah leng nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uh.
english: If it is on the bed, or on anything whereon she sits, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.

paite: Kuapeuh in akithuahpih a, asi neih luang in amah asuk khakleh ni sagih sung siang lou ahi dia; alupna peuhmah siang lou ahi vek ding hi.
english: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed whereon he lies shall be unclean.

paite: "Numei asi neih ngeina hilou, ni sawtkuamtak a sipawt hiam, anitdan ngeina sang a sawtzaw sipawt hiam ahihleh, asianlouhdan ngeina sung a, a-om zel bang in sipawtmi anit sung teng siang lou in a-om ding hi.
english: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period; all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period: she is unclean.

paite: Asipawt sung teng alupna taphot asiang louh ngeina hun lai a, alupna bang ahi dia; atutna peuhmah asian louh ngeina hun lai a, asiang louh bang in siang lou ahi ding.
english: Every bed whereon she lies all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period: and everything whereon she sits shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her period.

paite: Kuapeuh huai thil khoih peuhmah siang lou ahi dia, apuante asawp dia, akisil ding ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Himahleh asipawt pen siansak ahihleh ni sagih ama'n akisim dia, huchi in ahong siangta ding hi.
english: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

paite: Ani giat ni in vakhu kop khat hiam, vapalnou kop khat hiam atawi dia, kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah siampu ahong pe ding ahi.
english: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Siampu in khelh thoihna ding in khat, halmang thillat ding in khat alan ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in sipawtmi asianlouhna thu ah TOUPA ma ah kilemna abawlsak ding ahi.
english: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Yahweh for the uncleanness of her discharge.

paite: "Hiai bang in Israel suante asianlouhna ua pan na hihtuam ding uh ahi; alak ua ka biakbuk ahihbuah khak chiang ua leng asianlouhna ua asihlouhna ding un.
english: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is in their midst.’”

paite: "Hiai dan pasal thilpawt neimi leh kipolhna a pan chi pawtkhia a ninte leh
english: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean thereby;

paite: numei kha teng si neih sung a ding, pasal hi in numei hitaleh sa a pan thilpawt neimi a ding leh siang lou a ngaih numei kithuahpih pasal a ding ahi," achi hi.
english: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.
